ESP Web Tools 10.4.0, by ESPHome (Nabu Casa), Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE.txt).
Source: https://github.com/esphome/esp-web-tools, its npm package's dist/web/ folder, copied
here unchanged on 2026-11-23 for the puck's page (puck.html) to install the puck's firmware
from the browser.

The firmware it installs, firmware/astroturbomaxipuck.bin, is AstroTurboMaxiPuck, GPL-3.0-only,
built from https://github.com/sh3n1/AstroTurboMaxiPuck at the commit named in
firmware/manifest.json.
